It's simple.  Each user has to copy and paste adding only one song to the album so in the end it's 12 songs.

THE TWELVE SONG ALBUM GAME RULES

* each album has 12 songs; you are allowed only ONE contribution per album

* you must pick a song that has been officially released.  A "bootleg" recording of an unreleased song is not eligible here.

* whoever finishes one theme gets to also set and start the next theme.  And so on....

* previous themes may be repeated but the previous picks must be located and re-posted so that no songs duplicate themselves between different volumes.

It is up to whoever sets the theme to clarify any ambiguities about it, so long as none of the basic rules above are compromised.  Be sure to make sure you are editing correctly and not missing anyone's choices.

Please post as "track number > artist > song title", for easier and consistent reading.

Also, it helps me great in compiling this list if we could number the themes as we go.   Please.

Cool?

posts.text:
wow, this thread took off more than I thought!  I really enjoy seeing some of your responses, keep it up!

With a recap posted above, perhaps it might be good to remind everyone of the few simple rules here:

* each album has to have a different theme.

* Whoever adds the last song of the album gets to say what the theme for the next album will be and it starts all over again.  They also get to start that theme off with it's first track.  Got it?

* songs must be as they would appear on an official release.  No live versions from bootlegs, unreleased studio stuff, fantasy indulgences etc.  Song doesn't exist except in your own mind?  Can't make the album.

* you're allowed one choice per album

* where two posts are made simultaneously, it is up to the author of the second of the two posts (as they appear on the board) to edit and re-post the list accordingly.  Always a good idea to check your post after you've sent it.

* please post as "track number > artist > song title", for easier reading.
